issues.problem: The quotient structure is characterised from M̃: it is the unique maximal a.e. atlas making e ↦ [D e] an a.e. morphism for p^*B_M. Nothing states that the 𝐌³-inclusion charts of D(M̃) (local sections of D(M̃) → ρ\D(M̃) at regular points, followed by the inclusion in 𝐌³) belong to h^*B_M. The paper's wording ('endowing D(M̃) with …') reads most literally as that descended 𝐌³-structure. The two agree mathematically, because D is a developing map, and the rendering is exactly the one the library accepted for rem:tamely_singular_manifold_admits (GX.tamely_singular_manifold_admits_aeIso) and the one the round-2 audit prescribed. So this is not a weakening.
